theme: Light theme, high-contrast. Warm human details via restrained off-white backgrounds and a neutral base with ONE restrained accent color.

headings.usage: Display and Headings (H1-H4). High impact, clean, technical.

body.usage: Paragraphs, lists, UI text. Highly readable, pairs well with industrial design themes.

accent.description: Burnt Orange - used sparingly for buttons, active states, text links, and hover reveals.

spacing_and_layout.system: 8px Tailwind spacing scale (p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32)
spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 (Max width 1280-1440px)
spacing_and_layout.featured_cards: Alternate 7/5 ratio: md:col-span-7 for Image, md:col-span-5 for Content. Swap order on every other row.
spacing_and_layout.case_study: Reading content restricted to 8 columns (e.g., md:col-start-3 md:col-span-8). Visuals span 10 or 12 columns.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist approach. Flat with 1px borders. No large diffuse drop shadows. Focus on structure.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Subtle reveals (e.g., text links show a right arrow, images slightly scale up inside overflow-hidden wrappers).
visual_enhancers.focus_states: Visible focus states using the accent color (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D95A3B] focus:outline-none).

components.header: Sticky desktop header with compact mobile menu (hamburger). bg-[#F9F9F8]/90 with backdrop-blur-md. Clean nav links.
components.hero: Left-aligned. Eyebrow text, large H1, CTAs, and a strong right-aligned or bottom-anchored project visual.
components.credibility_strip: Horizontal row of stats or client/award logos. Subtle grayscale.
components.project_card: Image-first. No decorative card backgrounds. Image, title, tags, description, 'Read Case Study ->' link.
components.additional_work_list: List/table format with clear typography. Columns: Year, Title, Role.
components.case_study_template: 10 sections: Problem -> Research -> Direction -> Ideation -> Mechanisms/Diagrams -> Prototyping -> Final Solution -> Outcomes -> Reflection.
components.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary: bg-[#D95A3B] text-white. Secondary: transparent with 1px border.

motion.transitions: Restrained. Use 'transition-colors duration-200' or 'transition-transform duration-300 ease-out'.
motion.entrance: Framer Motion for gentle fade-up on scroll (y: 20 to y: 0, opacity 0 to 1). Do not over-animate.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance for text.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.

universal_travel_adapter.description: Black travel adapter on white marble.

dual_zone_streetlight.description: Modern LED streetlight on a concrete pole against blue sky.

hybrid_medical_vehicle.description: Bright yellow modern ambulance parked outdoors.

ideation_sketches.description: Detailed technical drawings on neatly arranged white paper sheets.

designer_sketching.description: Close up of hands sketching designs.

prototyping_work.description: Designer at desk working on physical layouts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create pages: Home, Work (Index), Case Studies (3+), About, Resume, Contact.
Implement the 12-column grid and alternate 7/5 column ratios for featured projects on the homepage.
Ensure the case study template strictly follows the 10 specified sections and the 8-column reading width constraint.
Implement a contact form using Shadcn UI inputs on the Contact page, and integrate Sonner for success toasts.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for clean, minimalist iconography.
Keep backgrounds restrained to #F9F9F8 and #F0F0EE. Let the product imagery bring richness.
Do not use unnecessary border radii on major layout blocks. Keep the industrial, technical feel.
Install and configure Sora and IBM Plex Sans fonts via Google Fonts or standard imports.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep styling flat and industrial.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or lightly rounded) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (kebab-case, role-based).
